code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    candidates = []
    for color, area in counts.items():
        if color == bg:
            continue
        cells = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        # The selected frame has complete top and bottom edges and both sides.
        closed = all(grid[r0][c] == color and grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(grid[r][c0] == color and grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1))
        if closed and any(grid[r][c] == bg for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1)):
            candidates.append((color,area,(r0,r1,c0,c1)))
    target,_,box = candidates[0]
    filler = min(((color,area) for color,area in counts.items() if color not in (bg,target)), key=lambda x:x[1])[0]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=box
    return [[target if grid[r][c] != bg else filler for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]

from itertools import combinations

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            color=grid[r][c]; q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                x,y=q.pop(); cells.append((x,y))
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    a,b=x+dx,y+dy
                    if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and (a,b) not in seen and grid[a][b]==color:
                        seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
            rs=[x for x,y in cells]; cs=[y for x,y in cells]
            box=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)); r0,r1,c0,c1=box
            holes=[(x,y) for x in range(r0,r1+1) for y in range(c0,c1+1) if grid[x][y]==bg]
            comps.append({'color':color,'cells':cells,'box':box,'holes':holes,'area':len(cells)})
    frames=[o for o in comps if o['holes']]
    solids=[o for o in comps if not o['holes']]
    solid_colors=list(dict.fromkeys(o['color'] for o in solids))
    areas={color:sum(o['area'] for o in solids if o['color']==color) for color in solid_colors}
    best=None
    for target in frames:
        nh=len(target['holes'])
        for mask in range(1,1<<len(solid_colors)):
            used=[solid_colors[i] for i in range(len(solid_colors)) if mask>>i&1]
            diff=abs(nh-sum(areas[c] for c in used))
            key=(diff,-target['area'])
            if best is None or key<best[0]: best=(key,target,used)
    _,target,used=best
    out=[[target['color'] if grid[r][c]!=bg else None for c in range(target['box'][2],target['box'][3]+1)] for r in range(target['box'][0],target['box'][1]+1)]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=target['box']; holes=set(target['holes']); regions=[]
    while holes:
        seed=next(iter(holes)); q=[seed]; holes.remove(seed); region=[]
        while q:
            x,y=q.pop(); region.append((x,y))
            for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                p=(x+dx,y+dy)
                if p in holes: holes.remove(p); q.append(p)
        regions.append(region)
    source_objs=[o for o in solids if o['color'] in used]
    for region in regions:
        rs=[x for x,y in region]; cs=[y for x,y in region]; rh=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; rw=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
        def score(o):
            a,b,c,d=o['box']; oh=b-a+1; ow=d-c+1
            return (abs(oh-rh)+abs(ow-rw),abs(o['color']-target['color']))
        color=min((o for o in source_objs),key=score)['color'] if len(used)>1 else used[0]
        for x,y in region: out[x-r0][y-c0]=color
    return out
'''
